label: Ignatius of Antioch writes to Polycarp, bishop of the church at Smyrna

date.note: Ignatius wrote en route to martyrdom at Rome. Eusebius (Hist. eccl. 3.36) places the journey under Trajan (reigned 98–117), traditionally c. 107–110; the range brackets the later part of Trajan's reign. A minority redates the letters to c. 125–150 (Barnes 2008).

primary.cite: Ignatius, To Polycarp, salutation (Polycarp, bishop of the church of the Smyrnaeans)

secondary.cite: Harnack, Mission and Expansion, vol. 2, pp. 185–186

notes: The letter to Polycarp, distinct from the letter to the Smyrnaeans (lit-ignatius-smyrna). It attests the same Smyrna church (Pleiades 550893) and names its bishop, Polycarp, a fixed prosopographical anchor for the community c. 110.
